name: Story endings
notes: Four endings. The Ticket is where most locks happen. Choices are permanent on that character.
Vendored from the wiki (The Ticket, Endings) and community guides. Tarkov.dev does not ship story chapters.
Difficulty ranks are a community read of time and grind, not an in-game rating.

endings.name: Savior
endings.tagline: Expose TerraGroup and leave with the truth.

difficulty.label: Hardest
difficulty.note: Eight major evidence pieces, Fence 4.0, 40 bitcoin, BTR 0.4, and the Terminal raid with Alpha-1 on you. Longest route by a wide margin.

endings.summary: Accept Kerman, agree to dig up dirt on TerraGroup, hand in 8 of 9 major evidence, then extract through the Terminal carrying the Alpha-1 container.
endings.accessItem: Reprogrammed RFID keycard with Mr. Kerman's hash codes

rewards.name: Savior hideout ceiling, walls and floor
T H I C C Weapon case
T H I C C item case
Endgame ammo packs (.338 AP, 7.62 BS, 9.3 7N33, 9×39 BP, 40mm, AP-20)

endings.name: Survivor
endings.tagline: Refuse Kerman and buy your way out.

difficulty.label: Medium
difficulty.note: Mechanically simple. The bill is 300 million roubles if you gave Prapor the case, 500 million if you kept it. Kept-case also puts a 72-hour timer on three tasks, or you lose Kappa.

endings.summary: Refuse Kerman's offer, pay Prapor a fortune, take his letter, and extract through the Terminal. TerraGroup walks.
endings.accessItem: Prapor's letter for the port checkpoint

rewards.name: Survivor hideout ceiling, walls and floor

endings.name: Debtor
endings.tagline: Start with Kerman, then walk away owing Lightkeeper.
endings.epilogue: Escaped from Tarkov but didn't escape from yourself.

difficulty.label: Hard
difficulty.note: No huge cash payment, but 30 PMC kills on Woods, 100 dogtags, and six sacred amulets from marked rooms. The grind ending.

endings.summary: Accept Kerman and agree to find dirt, hand in exactly two major evidence pieces, then refuse to continue. Lightkeeper is your way out.

rewards.name: Mercenary hideout ceiling, walls and floor
T H I C C Weapon case
Endgame ammo packs (.338 AP, 6.8 Hybrid, 7.62 M993, AP-20)

endings.name: Fallen
endings.tagline: Turn on Kerman and leave with Prapor's smugglers.
endings.epilogue: Escaped from Tarkov to fall in the darkness.

difficulty.label: Medium
difficulty.note: Straightforward once you refuse the dirt job. The price is $1,000,000 plus the Case with dangerous cargo. Keeping the armored case adds a big electronics and repair-kit handover.

endings.summary: Accept Kerman, then refuse to find dirt on TerraGroup. Pay Prapor in cargo and dollars. You still extract — on the darkest terms.
endings.accessItem: Reprogrammed RFID keycard with Prapor's hash codes

rewards.name: To Fall in the Darkness poster
Fallen in the Darkness hideout ceiling, walls and floor
Dusk of Humanity main menu background

locks.name: Lock 1 — the armored case
locks.prompt: Keep the case from the Woods plane, or hand it to Prapor?

options.label: Keep the case
options.hint: You open it yourself. Easiest Savior path. Survivor then costs 500M and adds a 72-hour timer.

options.label: Give it to Prapor
options.hint: Survivor drops to 300M. Savior and Debtor then need Lightkeeper to get the case back.

locks.name: Lock 2 — Mr. Kerman
locks.prompt: After the case opens, Kerman offers to activate the keycard. Accept or refuse?

options.label: Accept Kerman
options.hint: Opens Savior, Debtor and Fallen. Craft the activated RFID (~50 hours).

options.label: Refuse Kerman
options.hint: Locks Survivor. Pay Prapor 300–500 million roubles.
options.warning: Refuse Kerman = Survivor. This is permanent.

locks.name: Lock 3 — dirt on TerraGroup
locks.prompt: The first Shoreline swipe fails. That is normal. Kerman then asks you to gather dirt on TerraGroup.

options.label: Agree to find dirt
options.hint: Opens Savior and Debtor. You will hunt major evidence next.

options.label: Refuse the dirt job
options.hint: Locks Fallen. $1,000,000 plus cargo to Prapor.
options.warning: Refuse the dirt job = Fallen. Worst ending.

locks.name: Lock 4 — how much evidence
locks.prompt: Hand in major evidence at Intelligence Center 3. After two pieces Kerman offers an early exit. Do not take it on a Savior run.

options.label: Hand in 8 of 9
options.hint: Locks Savior. You can miss exactly one major piece. Do not skip Ms. A.

options.label: Stop at 2 and walk away
options.hint: Locks Debtor. Lightkeeper's chain from here.

chapters.name: Tour
chapters.summary: Tutorial and map unlocks. No ending choice. Start the evidence storylines during Tour — on Savior that is 8 of 9 major pieces and it saves weeks.
chapters.howToStart: Starts after the tutorial on Ground Zero.

steps.title: Escape Ground Zero
steps.detail: Tutorial raid. Extract Klimov Street, behind Skyside. On-screen hints are optional.

steps.title: Talk to Therapist
steps.detail: Trader screen. She is the only trader at the start. The next dialogue asks for 250,000 roubles to unlock Streets of Tarkov.

steps.title: Hand Therapist 250,000 RUB to open Streets
steps.detail: Hand Therapist 250,000 roubles. Not found-in-raid. Optional: collect the cash first. Reward unlocks Streets of Tarkov.

steps.title: Unlock Interchange — extract Survived or Run-Through (or visit 3 times)
steps.detail: Extract Interchange as Survived or Run-Through, or enter the map 3 times. Unlocks Skier and Customs.

steps.title: Unlock Customs — extract Survived or Run-Through (or visit 3 times)
steps.detail: Extract Customs as Survived or Run-Through, or enter the map 3 times. Then Skier asks for 5 found-in-raid building materials or tools in one handover.

steps.title: Hand Skier 5 found-in-raid building materials
steps.detail: Hand over 5 found-in-raid items from building materials or tools. Partial handovers are refused. Unlocks Mechanic and Factory.

steps.title: Unlock Factory — extract Survived or Run-Through (or visit 3 times)
steps.detail: Extract Factory as Survived or Run-Through, or enter the map 3 times. Then Mechanic asks for 2 found-in-raid weapons.

steps.title: Hand Mechanic 2 found-in-raid weapons
steps.detail: Hand Mechanic any 2 found-in-raid weapons. Unlocks Prapor and Woods.

steps.title: Unlock Woods — 3 kills and extract Survived or Run-Through
steps.detail: Kill any 3 targets on Woods (can be a different raid from the extract). Extract Survived or Run-Through, or visit 3 times. Unlocks Peacekeeper and Shoreline.

steps.title: Shoreline port intercom — press once, then extract
steps.detail: South-east watchtower in front of Terminal. Do not walk the Terminal wall; the guards shoot accurately. Pressing the intercom again after being told to leave also kills you.

steps.title: Hand Prapor 5 PMC dogtags to open Reserve
steps.detail: Extract Shoreline Survived or Run-Through (or visit 3 times), then hand Prapor 5 PMC dogtags. Tags need not be found-in-raid and need not be your kills — loot them off dead PMCs. Unlocks Reserve.
steps.location: Prapor trader screen, after a Shoreline extract

steps.title: Hand Mechanic 8,000 USD to open Lighthouse
steps.detail: Hand Mechanic 8,000 USD. Not found-in-raid. Dollars can be bought from Peacekeeper. Unlocks Lighthouse.

steps.title: Transit into The Lab, search O21, the server room, and the drainage extract
steps.detail: Transit in with a TerraGroup Labs access keycard. Streets: underground in front of Klimova 16A (cosmonaut painting). Factory: sewer off the flooded underground. Transits open 1 minute after raid start. Search the lab manager office O21 on level 2, the server room beside the hangar on level 1, and the drainage path at Sewage Conduit in the basement. You do not have to extract.
steps.location: O21 (2nd floor), server room by the hangar (1st), Sewage Conduit (basement)

chapters.name: Falling Skies
chapters.summary: Crashed plane on Woods. Loot the wreck, extract the armored case, then decide who keeps it. This is Lock 1.

steps.title: Find the crashed plane on Woods
steps.detail: Find the crashed plane in eastern Woods. Walking up to the wreck starts Falling Skies after Tour.

steps.title: Reach Prapor loyalty 2, then ask five traders about the plane
steps.detail: Reach Prapor loyalty 2, then ask Prapor, Therapist, Skier, Mechanic and Jaeger about the plane. Prepare for Escape, Edge of Darkness and The Unheard skip the loyalty gate.

steps.title: Shoreline: G-Wagon flash drive (Tunnel extract)
steps.detail: Flash drive on the driver-side running board of the G-Wagon next to Tunnel extract on Shoreline. Found in raid. Optional: pay Therapist 2,000 USD and she marks the SUV. Hand the drive to Prapor and wait about 1 hour.

steps.title: Pull the flight recorder from the Woods wreck, stash it on Shoreline island
steps.detail: Right side of the plane, broken section near the back, FiR. Stash it in the destroyed room of Fisher's Island house — do not hand it to a trader.
steps.location: Plane right-side wreck · Shoreline island house

steps.title: Hand Prapor 2 FiR toolsets, 3 rechargeable batteries, 5 PCBs
steps.detail: Hand Prapor 2 found-in-raid toolsets, 3 found-in-raid rechargeable batteries and 5 found-in-raid printed circuit boards. All three can be crafted at the workbench. Then wait 3–5 hours.

steps.title: Chairman's house: crew transcript + Elektronik's flash drive
steps.detail: Chairman's house on Shoreline. Pick up and read the flight-crew transcript under the mattress of the overturned bed. Elektronik's secure flash drive is on the shelf by the bed. Hand both to Prapor (300,000 roubles, more with Intelligence Center). Wait 1–3 hours.
steps.location: Chairman's house, Shoreline — transcript under the overturned-bed mattress; Elektronik drive on the shelf by the bed

steps.title: Take the armored case from behind the cockpit
steps.detail: Take the armored case from behind the cockpit of the Woods wreck. Dying in raid loses it. Optional clue: Note from Mr. Kerman on the pilot seat.

steps.title: KEEP the armored case
steps.detail: Do not give it to Prapor. Easiest Savior path: you open it yourself and skip the Lightkeeper retrieval.

steps.title: Give the case to Prapor
steps.detail: Cuts Survivor from 500M to 300M. For Savior or Debtor you will have to get the case back through Lightkeeper.

chapters.name: Get the case back
chapters.summary: Only if you gave Prapor the case. Lightkeeper has to retrieve it before you can open it.
chapters.howToStart: After giving Prapor the case in Falling Skies, Kerman sends you to Lightkeeper.

steps.title: Find Prapor's camp on Lighthouse
steps.detail: Find the camp of Prapor's people on the Lighthouse peninsula and pick up the note about their intentions.

steps.title: Unlock Lightkeeper and stay on good terms
steps.detail: Mechanic's quest To the Light — Trust but Verify. You need an encoded DSP radio transmitter to cross the bridge to the lighthouse. Lightkeeper is on the 3rd floor. Do not harm Zryachiy.
keys: Encoded digital secure DSP radio transmitter

steps.title: Hand Lightkeeper 3 TerraGroup Blue Folders
steps.detail: Find three TerraGroup Blue Folders in raid and hand them to Lightkeeper.

steps.title: Yellow flare at ULTRA, then 15 kills on Interchange
steps.detail: Fire a yellow signal flare in front of ULTRA's main entrance, then eliminate 15 targets in one Interchange raid. Extracting early resets both.

steps.title: Collect the armored case from Lightkeeper
steps.detail: Talk to Lightkeeper with a free special slot. He returns the armored case.

chapters.name: Open the case
chapters.summary: Workbench plus a Labs jammer. The craft takes about 55 hours. Inside: Kruglov's RFID and the manual.
chapters.howToStart: Ask Mechanic for help once you have the armored case.

steps.title: Build Intelligence Center 1
steps.detail: Needed to talk to Kerman on the laptop. Start this as soon as you can afford it.

steps.title: Ask Mechanic how to open the case
steps.detail: Trader screen. He sends you after an experimental signal jammer in The Lab. It must be found in raid.

steps.title: Find the experimental signal jammer (found in raid)
steps.detail: Three Labs spots: containment block glass lab (middle desks), recreational area R21 (round table in Cat, near Red), lecture hall R16 (conference desks downstairs from the kitchen).

steps.title: Craft the case open at Workbench 1 (~55 hours)
steps.detail: Start the armored-case opening craft at Workbench 1. It takes about 55 hours. Then unpack the result.

steps.title: Unpack Kruglov's RFID and read the manual
steps.detail: Right-click the opened case and unpack it. Kruglov's RFID goes to your stash. The manual is in the Handbook — open and read it.

steps.title: Contact Kerman on the Intel Center laptop
steps.detail: This is the lead-in to Lock 2. Wait 2–6 hours for him to reach out, then talk to Prapor and back to Kerman.

chapters.name: The Ticket — Lock 2
chapters.summary: Kerman offers to activate the keycard. Accept for Savior, Debtor or Fallen. Refuse for Survivor.
chapters.howToStart: After the case is open and you have read the RFID manual.

steps.title: ACCEPT Kerman's offer
steps.detail: Point of no return. Declining ends every route except Survivor.

steps.title: REFUSE Kerman's offer
steps.detail: Locks Survivor. You will pay Prapor 300 or 500 million roubles.

steps.title: Get Labs Black keycard and Kruglov's master pass
steps.detail: You need a TerraGroup Labs access keycard (single use, bought or found) and Kruglov's master pass from the unpacked case. Used later for the Terminal and Cardinal routes.
steps.location: Labs access keycard (any Labs entrance) and Kruglov's master pass from the opened case

steps.title: Farm 40 Physical Bitcoin for Mechanic
steps.detail: Produce or otherwise obtain 40 Physical Bitcoin and hand them to Mechanic. This is the Savior/Debtor payment, not a raid pickup.

steps.title: Streets: Elektronik apartment device
steps.detail: Find and use the device in Elektronik's apartment on Streets. Check the quest item spawns inside the apartment after you have the key the quest names.

steps.title: Activate Kruglov's RFID (~50 hour craft)
steps.detail: Intelligence Center 1 craft. Then swipe it at the Shoreline intercom — the first swipe fails. That is normal.

steps.title: Swipe Shoreline intercom — it fails. That is normal.
steps.detail: 21:00–06:00 at the port intercom. The failed swipe is scripted. Do not panic. Kerman will ask for the dirt job next.

chapters.name: The Ticket — Lock 3
chapters.summary: After the failed swipe, Kerman asks you to gather dirt on TerraGroup. Agree for Savior or Debtor. Refuse for Fallen.
chapters.howToStart: After the first Shoreline swipe fails.

steps.title: AGREE to find dirt on TerraGroup
steps.detail: Point of no return. You will need Intelligence Center 3 to turn evidence in. After two pieces he offers an early exit — do not take it on Savior.

steps.title: REFUSE the dirt job
steps.detail: Locks Fallen. Prapor wants $1,000,000 and the Case with dangerous cargo.

steps.title: Build Intelligence Center 3
steps.detail: You cannot turn major evidence in until this is up. Long build — start it the moment you agree.

chapters.name: Evidence hunt — Lock 4
chapters.summary: Nine major pieces. Savior needs any 8. Do not skip Ms. A. After two hand-ins Kerman offers an exit — that exit is Debtor.
chapters.howToStart: Optional chapters can be started during Tour. Hand-in is Intelligence Center 3.

steps.title: Hand in 8 of 9 major evidence
steps.detail: Tick the pieces below as you extract them. Confirm with Kerman only when you have eight. Never stop at two on a Savior run.

steps.title: Hand in exactly 2, then refuse to continue
steps.detail: Locks Debtor (U-Turn achievement). Lightkeeper becomes the way out.

chapters.name: Side gates
chapters.summary: Fence 4.0, the two co-op extracts, and BTR Driver 0.4. PvE replaces the extracts with PMC-kill raids.
chapters.howToStart: Kerman's trusted contact (Fence) reaches out after the evidence is in.

steps.title: Fence reputation 4.0 and his assignments
steps.detail: Keep standing above 4.0 while you finish what he asks.

steps.title: PvP: extract Friendship Bridge (co-op) on Woods
steps.detail: Need a teammate. PvE instead: eliminate 5 PMCs in one Interchange raid without killing Scavs.
steps.location: Woods Friendship Bridge · PvE: Interchange, 5 PMCs, no Scavs

steps.title: PvP: extract Scav Lands (co-op) on Reserve
steps.detail: Need a teammate. PvE instead: eliminate 5 PMCs in one Shoreline raid without killing Scavs.
steps.location: Reserve Scav Lands · PvE: Shoreline, 5 PMCs, no Scavs

steps.title: BTR Driver 0.4 via Price of Independence
steps.detail: Do not pick Choose Your Friends Wisely on the BTR line — it can brick 0.4.

chapters.name: Hideout + pay
chapters.summary: Intelligence Center 3, Solar Power 1, 40 bitcoin, Labs Black plus Cardinal, then the final Kerman hash-code RFID craft.
chapters.howToStart: These builds are long. Start Solar Power the moment you can afford it.

steps.title: Intelligence Center level 3
steps.detail: Already required to turn evidence in. Confirm it is finished.

steps.title: Solar Power level 1
steps.detail: Long build. Start when you can afford it, not the night before Terminal.

steps.title: Hand Mechanic 40 Physical Bitcoin
steps.detail: Hand Mechanic 40 Physical Bitcoin from the Bitcoin farm or your stash. Not a raid spawn.

steps.title: Labs Black keycard + Cardinal apartment key
steps.detail: Savior needs both a TerraGroup Labs access keycard and the Cardinal apartment key before the Ms. A. transcript in the Cardinal safe.
steps.location: Cardinal apartments, Streets — and a Labs Black keycard

steps.title: Craft Kerman hash-code RFID
steps.detail: This is the Terminal access item for Savior. Bring it.

chapters.name: Pay Prapor
chapters.summary: 300 million if you gave him the case, 500 million if you kept it. Kept-case also starts a 72-hour timer.
chapters.howToStart: After refusing Kerman, talk to Prapor.

steps.title: Hand Prapor the cash
steps.detail: Hand Prapor cash. 300,000,000 roubles if you gave him the armored case in Falling Skies; 500,000,000 if you kept it.

steps.title: If you kept the case: finish Prapor's 72-hour tasks
steps.detail: SSD with TerraGroup evidence from four Labs folders, 50 kills on Streets, and 4 PMC kills in one raid. Fail the timer and you hand over Kappa instead.

steps.title: Take Prapor's letter for the port checkpoint
steps.detail: After the payment (and the timed tasks if you kept the case), take Prapor's letter. Swipe it at the Shoreline port intercom between 21:00 and 06:00.

chapters.name: Lightkeeper's price
chapters.summary: Ask every trader how to leave, then pay Lightkeeper in work: maps, PMC kills, dogtags and six sacred amulets.
chapters.howToStart: After you refuse to hand in more than two major evidence pieces.

steps.title: Ask the traders how to escape — Lightkeeper last
steps.detail: Ask the traders how to leave Tarkov. Lightkeeper is the one who actually offers the Debtor route — talk to him last, on the Lighthouse 3rd floor.

steps.title: Compile topographic intel from 5 maps onto a military flash drive
steps.detail: Pick up the topographic intel documents on Lighthouse, Woods, Customs, Ground Zero and Factory, record them onto a military flash drive, and hand the drive to Lightkeeper.
steps.location: Marked intel spots on Lighthouse, Woods, Customs, Ground Zero and Factory

steps.title: Eliminate 30 PMCs on Woods
steps.detail: Eliminate 30 PMCs on Woods. They do not have to be in one raid. Then continue Lightkeeper's amulet chain.

steps.title: Hand Lightkeeper 100 PMC dogtags
steps.detail: Start banking tags the moment you target Debtor.

steps.title: Stash 6 sacred amulets in the Lighthouse marked room
steps.detail: Customs dorm 314, two Streets marked rooms, three Reserve marked rooms (RB-VO, RB-PKPM, RB-BK). Stash each in the Lighthouse island stash.

steps.title: Buy Lightkeeper's RFID for 1 Blue Folders material
steps.detail: This is your Terminal access item on Debtor.

chapters.name: Prapor's smugglers
chapters.summary: If you kept the case, Prapor first wants electronics, a secure container and repair kits. Then cargo plus a million dollars.
chapters.howToStart: After refusing the dirt job, ask the traders how to leave, then talk to Prapor.

steps.title: Ask the traders how to leave Tarkov
steps.detail: Opens Prapor's smuggler line.

steps.title: If you kept the case: Prapor's extra tasks
steps.detail: 50 military or advanced electronics, a Theta / Epsilon / Kappa container, and 40 full-durability weapon and armor repair kits.

steps.title: Hand over the Case with dangerous cargo
steps.detail: Locate the case and give it to Prapor.

steps.title: Hand over 1,000,000 USD
steps.detail: The smuggler fee. Then wait for Prapor and collect his hash codes.

steps.title: Solar Power level 1
steps.detail: Required before Terminal on this route.

steps.title: Take the RFID with Prapor's hash codes
steps.detail: This is your Terminal access item on Fallen.

chapters.name: Terminal finale
chapters.summary: Shoreline intercom 21:00–06:00, swipe your access item, fight through Terminal, extract Zubr. Dying resets the raid, not the lock.

steps.title: Swipe your access item at the Shoreline intercom (21:00–06:00)
steps.detail: Savior: Kerman hash-code RFID. Survivor: Prapor's letter. Debtor: Lightkeeper's unnamed RFID. Fallen: Prapor's hash-code RFID.

steps.title: Armory: grab Alpha-1 and extract WITH it
steps.detail: Savior only. The Alpha-1 container is on the desk under the window in the armory. You must extract with it on you or it is not Savior. Fail the raid and you retry — the lock stays.
steps.location: Terminal armory, desk under the window

steps.title: Pass security, reach the pier, extract Zubr
steps.detail: Optional: drain the pumping station, grab the pier key, fight the last Black Division squad on the pier. The extract timer is three minutes. Everyone in the zone when it hits zero leaves, and the ending cinematic plays.

evidence.name: Agent network deployment report
evidence.howToStart: Bogatyr patch — Customs power-station sofa, or mattress spots.

evidence.name: Item #1156 specification
evidence.howToStart: EMERCOM leaflet in a green container at the Woods military camp.

evidence.name: Icebreaker archive data
evidence.source: In-game mail after decoding the drives
evidence.howToStart: Paradigm Shipping poster in raid, or Intelligence Center 3 radio.

evidence.name: Document mentioning the Warden
evidence.howToStart: Purification note in TerraGroup offices on Streets or Ground Zero.

evidence.name: Fuel catalyst test report
evidence.howToStart: Same chapter as the Warden document — Purification note, TG offices.

evidence.name: ARRS system specifications
evidence.howToStart: Cultist loot, Customs dorm 314, or the Woods circle.
evidence.note: Pressing the ARRS reset button before taking the flash drive destroys this piece. Kerman has one documented second chance if you missed it.

evidence.name: Transcript of conversation with Ms. A.
evidence.source: Cardinal apartment safe + Labs Black keycard
evidence.howToStart: No story chapter. Cardinal's safe on Streets, opened with Labs Black.
evidence.note: Do not skip this. It is the free extra so you can miss one chapter and still hit 8 of 9.

minorEvidence.name: Assistant's notes on Group #3 and Group #10
Assistant's notes on TG-Vi-24 test subjects
Copy of report for TG Worldwide
Document on changes in enterprise interactions
Note on preparations for the Arrival
Folder with intelligence on Norvinsk region facilities

warnings.text: Refuse Kerman after the case opens = Survivor
Refuse the dirt job after the failed swipe = Fallen
Hand in only 2 major evidence then quit = Debtor
Enter Terminal without the Alpha-1 container = not Savior
Choose Your Friends Wisely on the BTR line can brick 0.4 standing
They Are Already Here: do not press the ARRS reset before taking the flash drive
Kept the case on Survivor: miss the 72-hour tasks and you hand over Kappa
